held_out.question: A fruit shop receives 7 crates containing 24 pears each and sells 39 pears. How many pears remain?
Nine buses carry 48 passengers each. At the destination 64 passengers leave. How many passengers remain on the buses?
Maya has saved 125 dollars. She adds 18 dollars each week for 7 weeks, then spends 42 dollars. How many dollars remain?
A rope is 36 meters long. Eight pieces of 250 centimeters are cut from it. How many centimeters remain?
A baker starts with 54 rolls, bakes 3 trays of 16 rolls each, and sells 29 rolls. How many rolls remain?
A pool contains 960 liters. It receives 35 liters per minute for 12 minutes, then loses 180 liters. How many liters remain?
A trip is 800 kilometers long. A driver travels 135 kilometers per day for 3 days, then another 87 kilometers. How many kilometers remain?
A room has 14 tables with 6 seats each. Eleven seats are broken. How many usable seats remain?
A library has 236 books. It receives 5 boxes of 17 books each and donates 68 books. How many books remain?
A wallet contains 2000 cents. Three notebooks cost 275 cents each and two pens cost 125 cents each. How many cents remain?
